5862.title: Embedded browser native drag regions: verification blocked
5862.rootCauseOneLine: Native input could not be tested: both clean-checkout Electron attempts exited before startup because libglib-2.0.so.0 is unavailable. Native child-view attachment without app-region normalization is a plausible, unconfirmed mechanism.
5862.proposedFix: First verify physical input in an isolated macOS desktop; only then evaluate browser-content drag-region normalization across navigation and frames.
5862.caveats: Environment-blocked, not disproved. No native window or screenshot was possible. Existing mocked manager tests pass in both checkouts but cannot verify OS hit testing. No production fix or PR. The complete local diagnostic and outputs are inline in the report.
